target.title: Artifact classification is documented and reflected in loop context
target.test: The package must document how historical Codex Rust differentiated model-visible resources from UI artifacts, and the NDX loop must inject only concrete local artifact references into turn context.

steps.instruction: Inspect the new artifact analysis markdown document.
steps.expected: The document cites Rust paths for UserInput, contextual fragments, thread history items, MCP resource reads, and explains that UI artifacts are not blindly injected into model context.

steps.instruction: Inspect the NDX agent loop context code.
steps.expected: The loop scans model-visible history and the prompt for existing local artifact references and adds a bounded user context message before the prompt.

target.passCriteria: Artifact context behavior is code-backed and documented with Rust evidence.

target.instruction: Inspect the new artifact analysis markdown document.
target.expected: The document cites Rust paths for UserInput, contextual fragments, thread history items, MCP resource reads, and explains that UI artifacts are not blindly injected into model context.

steps.descript: The new artifact document records the Rust resource boundary and NDX contract.
evidence: packages/ndx/docs/agent-artifact-context.md cites codex-rs/protocol/src/user_input.rs, codex-rs/protocol/src/models.rs, codex-rs/core/src/context/fragment.rs, app-server-protocol/src/protocol/thread_history.rs, and MCP resource read paths.
packages/ndx/docs/agent-artifact-context.md states that UI thread artifacts are not a blanket future prompt inclusion rule.

target.instruction: Inspect the NDX agent loop context code.
target.expected: The loop scans model-visible history and the prompt for existing local artifact references and adds a bounded user context message before the prompt.

steps.descript: The loop adds bounded referenced artifact context for existing local files under cwd.
evidence: packages/ndx/src/agent/loop/artifacts.ts limits artifacts to existing files under cwd and caps the list at 8 with 1200-character text excerpts.
packages/ndx/src/agent/loop/state.ts inserts artifactContextMessages before skill messages and the user prompt.
Artifact smoke emitted a # Referenced Artifacts message for packages/ndx/docs/agent-artifact-context.md with path, size, modified_at, and excerpt.

result.descript: Artifact classification is documented and implemented as bounded local context.
evidence: The Rust evidence document and the TypeScript loop code agree on explicit resource inclusion.
The built smoke observed the expected artifact context message.
